decision.question: Compared with the source, is the image rendered pervasively as a pencil drawing, or is there perceptible but incomplete pencil-like treatment?
decision.criteria: Pass only if the scene as a whole is clearly and pervasively rendered as a pencil drawing, with visible pencil-like linework and shading representing the scene. Fail if there is no perceptible change toward pencil drawing; muted color or grain alone does not establish progress. If there is perceptible pencil-like treatment but it is incomplete or the scene remains substantially photographic, fail this condition because the required whole-scene transformation is not satisfied. Use unknown only when visual evidence is genuinely insufficient to determine whether the required transformation is satisfied.
